# Newsletter email template — media layout (spec)

**Scope:** the SENT newsletter email, generated by `builder/js/template.js`. This is the ERC's outward maroon design (Trebuchet MS, `#500000`, nested-table layout). It is NOT the Content Desk's steel-blue UI — do not apply desk tokens, fonts, or components here.

## The change

Items in research / spotlight / events / opportunities can carry a picture (`fields.image`). Today `itemImage()` (`builder/js/template.js:68`) renders it full-width, below the item text — plain, and long flyers dominate the section. Kate wants a nicer treatment.

Four candidate layouts, each mocked in the real template's markup (fonts, widths, colors): https://claude.ai/code/artifact/b41c3af2-d32f-459c-b008-5299679495d8
1. **Full width below** — today's.
2. **Thumbnail right** — image beside the text; text stays the star.
3. **Banner above** — image opens the item like a small hero.
4. **Framed inset + caption** — smaller, centered, hairline frame; calmest.

**First decision (Kate's):** one treatment everywhere, OR per-section (e.g. banner for spotlight, thumbnail for events). Everything after depends on this.

## Requirements

- **Email-safe.** Nested `<table>`, inline styles, no flex/grid — Outlook-friendly, matching how the whole template is already built.
- **Keep the maroon design.** The image treatment sits inside the existing 705px white section table; no desk styling.
- **Scheme-guarded** image src (the URL is a raw.githubusercontent link; keep the existing guard).
- **Applies at every `itemImage()` call site** — `buildBriefs` (research, line 153), the grouped-list renderers (lines 251, 260), `buildSpotlight` (line 431).
- **Degrades cleanly** — no image, renders nothing, exactly as today.

## Also flagged (confirm before touching)

- **Section-name mismatch.** The email band prints `"ERC Research"` (hard-coded, `template.js:124`) while the builder UI's Outline calls the same section "Featured Research." One should change — the email name is what subscribers see. Not part of the media change; fix only if Kate says so.

## Test

- `npm test` (builder tests run inside the desk suite).
- Render an issue that has an item image via the builder's Preview & Edit, inspect the generated email HTML.
- If possible, paste into Outlook web and eyeball it — the real target.

## Out of scope

- The Content Desk / builder UI style. The desk's media UPLOAD control is already done; this spec is only how the image RENDERS in the sent email.
